name: dsh-permission-rules
description: Declarative Claude Code-style permission rules for DeepSeek Harness: ordered allow/deny/ask rules with tool-name, argument (glob/regex), and workspace-path matching on the tools/pre-execute waterfall, full session-log audit, and HMR rule reload.
